SSO.resolution: Check the configured callback URL and identity-provider issuer.

INV.resolution: Regenerate the invoice from the billing portal and check the file status.

SYNC.resolution: Check service status and retry the documented synchronization workflow.

EXPORT.resolution: Reset the saved export column selection and regenerate the file.

INVITE.resolution: Ask an authorized workspace administrator to issue a new invitation.

MFA.resolution: Confirm device clock synchronization; use the approved account recovery workflow if needed.

SEARCH.resolution: Check indexing status and request the documented reindex workflow.

UPLOAD.resolution: Check supported file type and file size before retrying.

NOTIFY.resolution: Check notification preferences and delivery status.

ROLE.resolution: Ask an authorized administrator to verify the required role; do not bypass access controls.

WEBHOOK.resolution: Check endpoint health and retry through the delivery dashboard.

LOCALE.resolution: Review workspace timezone settings and refresh the affected view.
